QUOTE: Default (`MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` not defined): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `private_x`... Opt-out (`MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` defined): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `x`... "in these translation units `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` is just `x`, so `ctx.x` compiles"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining the macro sees plain names while ordinary consumers see `private_`-prefixed names, and names which code defines it.
